title: ERock (EROC) fiscal Q3 2026 results, before the open, call 8:30 a.m. ET — its second report as a public company and the last one before the lock-up ends
source: IR: ir.erock.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/137/erock-schedules-third-quarter-2026-results-and-conference-call — release dated October 22, 2026, 'ERock, Inc. (NYSE: EROC)... will issue its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, before market open on Thursday, November 12', call 8:30AM Eastern; the company's own site (and its IR calendar entry 20261112-third-quarter-2026-conference-call) fetched direct 2026-11-06, HTTP 200. A Business Wire copy on finviz agrees. Checked 2026-11-06
notes: Discovered during the eroc-lockup-expiry-2026-12-06 initial research (2026-11-06), promoted from estimate to confirmed on this event's own initial research the same day when the company's IR page was read. Why it is a dated event of its own: with 20-day realized vol at 126% it is the largest scheduled price event before the 2026-12-07 first sellable session, and it falls outside the lockup study's D-10..D+10 window, which opens 2026-11-20. Unlike the Q2 report (8-K filed 2026-08-11, reaction session 08-12) the release comes before the open, so the reaction session is 2026-11-12 itself. The Q2 report was followed by +22.8% on 08-12 and +13.3% on 08-13 (Yahoo daily bars), all of which was given back by 2026-10-14. Initial research: docs/research/events/erock-q3-2026-results-2026-11-12.md. FY2026 guide (Q2 8-K): revenue $435-465M, Adjusted EBITDA $3-9M against H1 revenue $71.6M and H1 Adjusted EBITDA -$26.4M, so H2 must carry $363-393M of revenue.
